name: Foz do Iguaçu
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Portuguese first-party discovery identified the municipal Foz do Iguaçu GeoPortal and municipal Cadastro Imobiliário procedure evidence. Anonymous GET requests reached the municipality selector and exposed the Foz municipality row, but the main application route redirected in a loop. No parcel geometry or native ID response was obtained.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 redirect page to the public GeoPortal route
HTTP 302 back to index.ctm; anonymous redirect loop
HTTP 200 JSF selector; Foz do Iguaçu / IBGE 4108304 / PR observed

scopeLimits: No bounded anonymous ID+geometry response was available, so no sample GeoJSON is retained.
The redirect loop and unusable app route are not evidence of citywide absence; the WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
The municipal GeoPortal establishes a local public cadastral route; CTMGEO is the hosting/application provider, while underlying service ownership remains unverified.
Only safe identity, geometry, CRS, and service metadata would be permitted; no raw attributes were retained and no unsafe fields were requested.

nativeFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: Not available because the parcel layer/API was not reached.

uncertainty: The local public cadastral portal is evidenced, but its map/API route was unavailable through anonymous requests during this attempt. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe fields were used.
